metadata.description: debuff: an open-source framework for making 2D browser games with AI agents

plugins.name: debuff
plugins.description: Make 2D browser games with Claude: start from a platformer, side-scroller, top-down, isometric or point-and-click template in a minute, then Claude plays it, sees it, tunes the feel, tests and fuzzes it, explains stutter and makes pixel art and music while you make the creative calls.
